sections.title: 2. Missing Edge Cases in Covered Functions
sections.content:
**`buildReadinessTrend`** — missing:
- Empty logs array → `status: 'neutral'`
- Single log → `status: 'neutral'`, `label: 'Baseline'`
- Stable trend (change = 0 or ±1) → `status: 'neutral'`

**`buildWeekSummary`** — missing:
- `weeksAgo` parameter (non-zero offset)
- Mobility and Test categories are never asserted
- Empty logs

**`calculateTrainingLogHealthScore`** — missing:
- Empty logs → returns `0`
- All-perfect logs → should approach `100`

**`buildWeeklyLoadRisk`** — missing:
- High ruck frequency (≥3 rucks)
- High run frequency (≥4 runs)
- High total sessions (≥6) with no recovery
- Dropping trend + 1 fatigue-watch session (combined high-risk trigger)

**`buildSessionRecommendation`** — missing:
- Empty logs → `sessionType: 'Start Logging'`
- Recommend Base Ruck (no ruck this week, good readiness)
- Recommend Strength Session
- Recommend Steady Run
- Progressive Load (improving trend, no fatigue)
- Continue Progression fallback

**`buildWeekPlan`** — missing:
- Progressive week (trend improving, ≥3 sessions, no fatigue)
- Standard week (stable readiness, no triggers)

**`filterAndSortLogs`** — missing:
- `'All'` filter passes all categories
- `'Oldest'` sort order
- `'Lowest Readiness'` sort order
- `showWeakLogsOnly: true` filters correctly
- Empty search query passes all logs

**`buildWeeklyReport`** — missing:
- Empty logs array
- Report with no notes (falls back to "No key notes available.")
- Report with no sessions (falls back to "No recent sessions logged.")
- `now` parameter actually controls `generatedAt`

sections.title: 3. Missing Error Handling Tests
sections.content:
- `getReadinessNumber('')` / `getReadinessNumber('abc')` → should return `0`
- `getDateValue('bad')` → should return `0`
- `buildWeeklyLoadRisk([], now)` → empty array, not just out-of-range dates
- `buildSessionRecommendation([])` → explicit empty case
- `calculateTrainingLogHealthScore([])` → explicit empty case
